title: Research: exact tri-plane factorization for selected P112 (no new kappa)
body:
This adds an exact algebraic decoder factorization for the selected 112 PR1094 complex labels using 37 mutually orthogonal 3-planes and one residual line. The stored F2 block solution reconstructs the full 112-by-112 pairing matrix and has B14 copy-rank profile `{7:3, 8:8}`, total 85, compared with 126 for the matched 2-plane factorization.

The proposed three-unpaid-coordinate local screen still misses `a = 1/99`: the exact relaxation at the target is `1.0002651999055365`, with a fixed-word ceiling `a = 0.010012347901`. This is before any physical tri-plane route, endpoint-translation multiplicity, hosting, frame/restoration or precision costs. No supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

### Evidence

- 24,416 pairwise-orthogonal independent triples in the pinned selected labels.
- Deterministic MRV exact cover with residual port 0; 10,000 covers checked. The F2 system has rank 81 over 334 variables. Its best result under the fixed zero-free-variable solver has block-rank histogram `{0:32, 1:2, 2:3, 3:1}` and 11 active terms.
- Exact 9-by-9 identity and full 112-by-112 decoder checks; 3,072 Gaussian-dyadic correction-operator basis cases; four negative controls.
- The 10,000-cover domain does not vary residual ports or nonzero free-variable solutions and is not a universal lower bound.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/tri-plane-port-p112-seeddb093026/verify.py
python3 -B research/tri-plane-port-p112-seeddb093026/search.py --cover-limit 10000
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/tri-plane-port-p112-seeddb093026 --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/tri-plane-port-p112-seeddb093026
```

The registered package replay validates the saved exact certificate and controls; it does not repeat the 10,000-cover search.

### Provenance

Research base: `ec94fd3d2fcad7ade8e72d6bcd8e223b7fdb3f30`. Selected-record SHA-256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`. This refines the `recursive-interfaces / coverage-law-change` assignment. It extends the 2-plane endpoint from Discussion #1587 and the matched P112 factorization in merged PR #1825 (head `d16fb8936795ff101e4d2f63cfdc6a25066ebabf`); PR #1900 is the distinct P111 bit-side plane result. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed.
